# /requirements
**Purpose:** produce/validate the requirements baseline (Delivery Process §6).
**Files to read:** `requirements.md`, `docs/_requirements/REQUIREMENT-template.md`, `docs/domain-rules.md`, `docs/glossary.md`.
**Steps:**
1. Fill FR/NFR with IDs + testable acceptance criteria; split modules if large.
2. Gap-review: ambiguity, missing AC, contradictions, untestable items, architecture leakage, missing edge cases/NFR.

**Approval gate:** BA/PO approve; QA confirms AC are testable.
